chunks: If the husband has no guardian, the ruler divorces her and brings two just witnesses to witness it. Then the ruler’s divorce is the husband’s divorce, and she observes a waiting period of four months and ten days; then she may marry if she wishes.

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا: the prescribed waiting period of four months and ten days
key_terms.الْوَالِي: the ruler or governing authority who executes the legal divorce
key_terms.شَاهِدَيْنِ عَدْلَيْنِ: two just witnesses required to witness the divorce
key_terms.وَلِيٌّ: guardian with legal authority on behalf of the husband

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a missing husband has no guardian to issue divorce?
ai.summary: This narration gives a fiqh ruling concerning the wife of a missing husband when no guardian exists for him. In that case, the ruler carries out the divorce with two just witnesses, and the woman then observes an 'iddah of four months and ten days before remarrying if she wishes.
